name: Shenzhen SEICHI Technologies Co., Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen SEICHI Technologies Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of new display device testing equipment in China. The company offers new display device testing solutions include optical inspection and calibration repair systems, aging systems, signal generation systems, instruments, and testing system accessories. It also provides semiconductor memory testing products, such as wafer testing machines and probe cards, aging test equipment, aging repair fixtures, and FT testing machines and fixtures.
